tiers.name: cookbook-content
tiers.holds: The cookbook content root itself: introduction/, principles/ (33), guidelines/ (245, use-case organized under planning/implementing/testing/reviewing/shipping/cookbook), ingredients/ (19), recipes/ (12), compliance/ (81 checks), workflows/ (6), reference/, appendix/, and index.md. All markdown, no code — the product this repo publishes, consumed by other projects as data (via /install-cookbook), not as a build-time import.

tiers.name: cookbook-cli
tiers.holds: The `cookbook` Python CLI package (cli.py, core/{checks,deps,errors,frontmatter,markdown,prompts,refs,roots,shell,ui}, indexing/, modules/{create,lint,plan,selfcmd,update,validate,prompt/}, registry.py) plus its tests/ and references-src/ (source content bundled into references/ at install time by install.sh). Self-contained; does not import cookbook-content — roots.py/refs.py locate a target project's own cookbook/ dir generically at runtime, not this repo's.

tiers.name: cookbook-skill
tiers.holds: The invocable Claude Code skill wrapper: SKILL.md (routes user/agent invocations to the installed `cookbook` CLI, never duplicating its logic) and bin/cookbook (the pre-install shim). A thin shell over cookbook-cli, kept separate because the skill wrapper and the CLI package it wraps are versioned/edited independently.

tiers.name: cookr-cli
tiers.holds: The `cookr` Python CLI package (core/{config,legacy,inventory,coverage,completeness,naming,recipes,organize,arrangement,relink}, modules/{inventory,coverage,organize,arrangement,relink,prompt/}) plus its tests/ and fixtures. Reads a repo's library cookbook (cookbook/cookbook.json and each spec's Reference Implementations) and imports cookbook-cli's refimpl, bump and frontmatter helpers.

tiers.name: cookr-skill
tiers.holds: The invocable cookr skill wrapper: SKILL.md (routes to the installed `cookr` CLI) and its shim. A thin shell over cookr-cli.

tiers.name: adh-plugin
tiers.holds: The Claude Code plugin packaging: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (registers this repo as the `agenticcookbook` local marketplace) and plugins/adh/ (plugin.json, README, gitignore). plugins/adh/skills/ itself is generated by install.sh from skills/ and gitignored, not tracked here.

tiers.name: entrypoints
tiers.holds: Root-level setup and CI hooks, listed by exact name: install.sh/uninstall.sh (install the `cookbook` CLI + plugin globally, assemble the plugin, register the marketplace) and .pre-commit-hooks.yaml (the cookbook-validate/cookbook-lint pre-commit hook definitions consumed by downstream repos).

tiers.name: docs
tiers.holds: Planning and research prose: docs/project-overview.md (+ its scan-hash), docs/pre-commit.md, docs/feedback/, docs/research/, and the superpowers plans/specs for the skill test harness, trigger-based filtering, and the cookbook prompt module.

tiers.name: superpowers-sessions
tiers.holds: Ephemeral state from past superpowers brainstorm sessions (slide-outline.html, server.log/.pid, server-stopped markers) that ended up committed rather than gitignored. Not source, not documentation — leftover session artifacts.

tiers.name: repo-meta
tiers.holds: How this repo is worked on rather than what it publishes: the project CLAUDE.md, its rules/ and skills/ (add-artifact, approve-artifact, create-artifact, install-cookbook-global, lint-artifact, repair-cookbook) and settings.json, git's ignore file, the repo-root README, and LICENSE.
